name: AgentLint
uses: Local pre-tool guardrails that inspect proposed file changes and shell commands, block secret and .env writes, force-pushes to main, CI edits and package publishing, and return a correction.
features: pre-tool hooks on file changes and shell commands
blocks secret writes, .env writes and force-pushes to main
blocks CI pipeline edits and package publishing
returns a correction on a block
next_gate: Trial agentlint ci --diff under $PFY_TMP over recent Deanery commits plus a seeded set of bad diffs, scored against check_public_paths.py and destructive-command-guard on catches, false positives and wall time. No hook installs into real agent homes, no settings edits, no blocking CI gate on main. No Feature GO.
non_goals: hook installs into real agent homes
